notes: Palette capped at 8 by census weight. Dropped (recorded here, not lost): #bdbdbd (weight 38, border/text; accordion dividers .cmp-accordion__item), #979797 (20), #ffffff99 (10, translucent white), #ede7fe (6, background only, bgArea 1480556 — light purple surface), #009ee0 (4, background only, cyan), #0000001a (2, scrim), #0000004d (2, scrim), #006431 (2, background only, green).

Heading weights: the four @font-face rules all declare font-weight 400 (bold/light are separate families), but the census computed font-weight 500 on 150/150 amag_displaybold headings — the theme sets weight 500 on headlines; the bold cut is carried by the family name, not the weight.
No font-display declared in any @font-face rule (0 of 4) — loadStrategy recorded as 'auto'.

Shadow rgba(0,0,0,.2) 0 4px 8px (mode, 20 occurrences): all 5 cited sources are #ot-sdk-btn-floating (OneTrust consent button) — third-party, not a brand motif. Treat shadows as effectively absent from brand surfaces.
heroImage.rect / domPath / localPath: the capture stores natural width/height for only (no bounding rect, no download); set null rather than invented.

heroMedium: home hero is a 4-slide image carousel (.amagCh-stageCarousel); no <video>, <iframe>, canvas, or motion library (hls/lottie/gsap/three) in the home capture. Auto-advance behaviour not observed — set null.
Line-heights come from the theme stylesheet (.amag-headline--h1..h6, .amag-copy--*), not the census, which did not record line-height.

System-component threshold is min(3, 50% of 5) = 2.5 → ≥3 pages. newsletter-band, news-cards and faq-cta-band appear on 2 of 5 pages and are listed with belowThreshold:true on parent instruction; the crawl is small and both are site-wide chrome by construction (AEM experience fragments).
cookie-consent: OneTrust (cdn.cookielaw.org, #ot-sdk-btn-floating) is present but was dismissed by auto-consent and is not captured as content.
og:* tags are null on all captured pages; tagline taken from <meta name=description>.

voice.firstParagraph: Welcome to the biggest car dealership in Switzerland. As official Swiss dealership, we at AMAG offer you all the models of all the Volkswagen brands. At AMAG, you will find online and on site a huge range of new, stock and used vehicles from car brands like Volkswagen, Audi, SEAT, Škoda, CUPRA, VW Commercial Vehicles and Bentley. Of course, our experts also offer all the services related to the car after the purchase – be it a repair in the workshop or a consultation at the garage!
